name: A BVG lump sum within 3 years of a buy-in reverses its deduction, Zurich
workings: A 30,000 buy-in in 2024 is within the lock (2026 − 3 = 2023 or later); the 2022 one isn't, and leaves the state.
The reversed deduction is added to this year's income: 30,000, with no other income.
No pension contributions this year, so the insurance deductions without them.
Simple tax 606.5000; cantonal 95% = 576.1750; communal (Zurich, 119%) = 721.7350; personal tax 24.
The lump sum is taxed separately: federal 5,220.6880; Zurich 2% floor (1/20 = 15,000 is taxed at 1.37%): simple 6,000, cantonal 5,700, communal 7,140.
At 64 without work, AHV without work: the minimum 556.50.
